binding_rule: No control may move upward in maturity based on implementation work alone. Promotion evidence must exist. Burden of proof is on enforcement, not documentation.

maturity_vocabulary.L2: Checker or test exists; partial coverage; bypass trivial
maturity_vocabulary.L4: Bypass requires privileged action + audit event

L1_to_L2: named enforcement location in code or CI
L2_to_L3: pre-commit or CI block on happy path
L3_to_L4: runtime enforcement or immutable audit event on bypass attempt
adversarial test spec entry with failing or passing harness

forbidden: Promote because test asserts checker==[] on current repo
Promote matrix status to ENFORCED without bypass inventory
Promote I-26 DR while release object undefined
